host.label: Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Transmission daemon

username.label: Username
username.description: RPC username; leave empty if authentication is disabled

password_file.label: Password file
password_file.description: File containing the RPC password (surrounding whitespace is ignored)

show_rate.label: Show transfer rate
show_rate.description: Show the download/upload rate next to the icon; it is always in the tooltip

hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle
hide_when_idle.description: Hide the widget while nothing is downloading or uploading

error.no_session_id: Daemon did not provide a session id
error.unauthorized: Authentication failed: check the username and password file
